searchText: For an EIP's motivation section, should it include rationale for why certain things were omitted from alternative EIP proposals? Or does that below in a discussion? That is good content for the Rationale section. The motivation is "why is this generally a useful thing", the rationale is "why were specific decisions/trade-offs made". Python does not sound like to be the best reference implementation language because it doesn't have typing. Will the implementation have some checks for types? Yep! We use mypy to do static type checking. You can see more at https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/tree/master/src/ethereum
